title: worktree remove kills bound session before git validates removal
description: run_remove in crates/phux/src/commands/worktree.rs kills the bound session BEFORE running git worktree remove, but only pre-checks 'current' and dirty state. git also refuses: main working tree, locked worktrees, submodules. Scenario: 'phux worktree remove main' from another worktree kills the primary session, then git refuses removal — session lost, worktree still there. Fix: mark first entry from 'git worktree list --porcelain' as is_main and refuse before killing; also check locked attribute. Found by research-team review of f1a1306..b7ffd45, adversarially verified.
notes: Fixed: WorktreeInfo now carries is_main (first porcelain entry) and locked; run_remove refuses main worktree and locked worktrees BEFORE killing the session. Parser test extended.

title: Seed pane inherits daemon CWD, not client cwd — breaks claude --resume
description: A claude (Claude Code) session started inside a phux shell can't be resumed: 'claude --resume' from the project dir finds no history. Root cause: the seed/initial pane never sets a cwd and inherits the daemon's cwd. Claude keys its transcript at HOME/.claude/projects/<cwd-hash>/*.jsonl on the pane's actual cwd (= daemon cwd), so the transcript IS written and flushed, just under the hash of the wrong directory. The session NAME is derived from the client cwd basename, so it looks like it's in the project dir while the pane runs in the daemon dir. HOME/env inherited correctly (not the cause); data not lost, just filed under wrong project hash. Fix: client should send its real cwd (not None) for the initial attach, and resolve_create_if_missing must apply it, mirroring the split path's resolve_inherited_cwd. Likely warrants an ADR. Verified against code: resolve_create_if_missing ignores _cwd (phux-server/src/runtime/attach.rs:159, doc-comment :140-142); client sends cwd:None (phux/src/commands/attach.rs:177); seed_session_with_pty sets no .cwd() (phux-server/src/runtime/commands.rs:63-94); split path DOES honor cwd (attach.rs:496-500). Secondary (lower prio): TerminalSignal::Kill group-SIGKILLs via killpg (terminal_actor/mod.rs:1324-1344), so killing a pane while claude is foreground gives no chance to flush; clean shell-exit reaps gracefully. Reported via phux-mobile bead phux-mobile-3ru. See SEED_CWD_BUG.md.
notes: Implemented on branch claude-persistence. Client (attach.rs:180) now sends real cwd via std::env::current_dir() in the Last->CreateIfMissing fallback; server resolve_create_if_missing (attach.rs) applies wire cwd to the seed pane's CommandBuilder in the PTY branch. Added acceptance test create_if_missing_seeds_pane_in_wire_cwd (spawn_terminal.rs) proving the seed pane runs in the wire cwd. Traced the real path: naked phux -> Last refused on fresh server -> CreateIfMissing{project-name} slow path = the reported name/cwd-mismatch case. Pre-seeded startup session already inherits the spawning client's cwd (fork), so no change needed there. No wire/spec change (cwd field already existed). Treated as bug fix, not ADR (code comment already documented the seed-in-server-CWD as a known follow-up). fmt+clippy clean.

title: implement MOVE_TERMINAL per accepted ADR-0056
description: ADR-0056 Accepted 2026-07-25 with zero implementation: no MOVE_TERMINAL/TERMINAL_MOVED in phux-protocol, no window-reassignment in phux-core registry (spatial.rs same_session() still rejects cross-session moves). Needs wire pair + spec/CHANGELOG bump + registry reassignment + caller-side rollback. Serves agent-fleet use case. Medium.

title: ADR status hygiene + relay spec addendum (ADR-0057 open question 1)
description: Flip ADR-0055 (shipped in f2483ca/77451c0), ADR-0031, ADR-0034 from Proposed to Accepted — status lines drifted from reality. Same pass: write QUIC_RELAY_ALPN, relay tunnel shape, and close-code registry into docs/spec/ + docs/spec/CHANGELOG.md per the docs/spec-is-normative convention. Small, cheap credibility win.

title: relay end-to-end: route/SNI in phux://connect links and phux attach
description: ADR-0057 open question 2: connector dials out (crates/phux-server/src/connector.rs) but consumers cannot express 'attach to server X via relay Y' through pair.rs or attach.rs — relay unusable without hand-wiring. Add relay route/SNI parameter to phux://connect links and phux attach. Completes the flagship remote-attach thread. Medium.

title: verify: clipped context menu after resize may intercept input / commit kill-pane invisibly
description: Unverified research-team finding (verify agent stalled): crates/phux-client/src/render/overlay/menu.rs:186-204,372-378 — after a resize clips the menu away, it may still intercept input and commit destructive actions (kill pane) while invisible. Needs manual verification: trace resize path vs input_dispatch routing; if real, close/clamp menu on resize.

title: claude shim execs real claude on ANY nonzero phux exit, incl. mid-session failure
description: render_wrapper in crates/phux/src/commands/agent/shim.rs: wrapper runs phux new ... && exit 0, else exec real claude with original argv. phux new exits nonzero on attach errors long after launch (server crash), so users silently get a fresh unhooked claude with re-run flags. Fix: mktemp marker written by the inner branch once the session starts; on nonzero exit only fall back to real claude if marker is empty, else print 'phux session ended abnormally' and propagate status. Verified by research team.
notes: Fixed: wrapper passes a mktemp sentinel as first --phux-inner arg; inner stamps it before exec'ing Claude. On nonzero exit the outer only falls back to direct Claude if the sentinel is empty (launch never started); otherwise prints 'session ended abnormally' and propagates status. /dev/null fallback if mktemp fails degrades to old behavior.

title: protocol version negotiation bypassable by skipping HELLO
description: b7ffd45 put the version check only inside the Hello arm of handle_client (crates/phux-server/src/runtime/client.rs), but the dispatch loop tolerates clients that never send HELLO, and nothing records whether negotiation happened. An incompatible or malicious client can omit HELLO and issue Attach/Command frames (incl. PutFile) unversioned. Fix: hello_seen flag; reject non-Hello frames before successful HELLO with ErrorCode::VersionIncompatible and close. Verified by research team.
notes: Fixed scoped to threat model: server now requires HELLO before any other frame on network transports (QUIC/WS/WebTransport/SSH-tunnel) via hello_seen flag in handle_client; UDS/Localhost keep the documented same-uid leniency because the CLI control commands (ask/state/snapshot/spawn) never HELLO. Full §6.1 enforcement would need client-side hello-on-connect in Connection constructors first — follow-up if desired.

title: Bottom banner overlaps cursor/prompt at window bottom
description: When the cursor reaches the bottom of the window, the bottom banner covers the cursor and prompt area, so the prompt is lost behind the banner.
design: Investigate: reduce the terminal viewport height by the banner height so the prompt's 'bottom' sits on top of the banner rather than under it. Check where the bottom banner and viewport layout are computed in phux-client chrome.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt area is reserved above the bottom banner: the banner and prompt stack without overlap, and the cursor/prompt at the bottom of the window stays fully visible.

title: ASCII QR code for 'phux pair' token (mobile scan)
description: Companion to the mobile-app QR bead. 'phux pair' (crates/phux/src/commands/pair.rs, ADR-0031) currently mints a bearer pairing token and prints it as plain text alongside the cert fingerprint for a wss:// consumer. The mobile app wants to scan a QR instead of copy/paste. Add an ASCII/Unicode QR rendering of the pairing payload (token + connection URL/fingerprint) printed to the terminal after minting. No QR code exists in the tree today (grep 'qr' finds none). Scope: pick a small qr-code crate (justify per no-new-deps rule), define the exact payload string the mobile app expects (coordinate with the phux-mobile QR bead), render half-block/ASCII QR, and gate behind a flag or make it default output. Ensure it degrades in narrow terminals.
close_reason: Implemented: phux pair --qr renders a Unicode QR of phux://pair?token=&fp=&host=, committed 4ae3707 on feat/phux-pair-qr (stacked on feat/phux-detach). qrcode dep added (deny ok). Payload format documented in ADR-0031 for the mobile team.

title: Add 'phux detach' CLI command mirroring the ctrl+a d keybinding
description: Today detach exists only as a client-side keybinding action ('detach', bound to ctrl+a d) in crates/phux-client/src/attach/action_registry.rs:248 ('Detach this client from the session'). There is no 'phux detach' subcommand (crates/phux/src/commands/ has attach/kill/etc. but no detach.rs). Add a 'phux detach' CLI verb so a client can be detached from outside the attach UI (e.g. scripting, or detaching a different/stuck client). Needs: new commands/detach.rs, wire into commands/mod.rs and the clap command tree, and a server path to signal the target client to detach (reuse whatever the keybinding action dispatches). Decide targeting: current client vs by session/client id.
close_reason: Implemented: DETACH_CLIENTS wire command + phux detach CLI, committed 7776a3d on feat/phux-detach. 857 tests green, spec updated.

title: per-consumer link sub-identities on federation link (ADR-0038 deferral)
description: All hub consumers collapse to one identity on the satellite: no per-consumer audit/authz, and link redial frees the satellite-side input lease while hub-side exclusion persists (documented flaw, spec draft.15). Prerequisite for multi-tenant/team (enterprise) deployments. Wire change: sub-identity tagging on relayed frames. Deserves its own ADR extending 0038. Large.

title: federate APPLY_INPUT: route acknowledged idempotent input to satellites
description: ADR-0053 built reconnect-safe input for unreliable remote consumers but scoped it local-only — APPLY_INPUT rejects SATELLITE TerminalIds, so the guarantee is missing exactly where transports fail. Extend over hub relay: operation-id cache on owning satellite, hub passes through verbatim like PUT_FILE (ADR-0059). Care: server_id incarnation semantics across the hop. Medium.

title: agent-detection manifests: gemini-cli (then cursor-agent, aider, goose)
description: Detection framework proven (ADR-0046, crates/phux-server/rules/*.toml, 5 manifests). gemini-cli ships a plugin integration (examples/plugins/agent-tools/integrations/gemini-cli.toml) but no rules manifest — users hit the inconsistency. Each agent = TOML manifest + identify fixtures/tests per verified-manifest pattern (47c039a, 9b2d8a2). Small, high leverage.

title: service.rs hardening: systemd %/$ escaping and HOME-unset launchd path
description: Two unverified low findings in crates/phux/src/commands/service.rs: (1) systemd unit does not escape % specifiers or $ expansion in ExecStart/Environment (lines ~831-845) — paths containing % or $ generate broken units; (2) with HOME unset, launchd unit files are written into the current directory (lines 66-77, 862-864). Verify and fix both.

title: phux enroll writes bearer token to disk before name/endpoint validation
description: run_enroll (crates/phux/src/commands/enroll.rs:224) calls write_token before NewRemote validation. Scenarios: --name '../../x' writes token outside <state>/remotes via unsanitized join before name rejection; quic endpoint without fingerprint fails AFTER token write, leaving orphaned 0600 bearer-token files. Fix: construct/validate NewRemote first (validate_token_file permits not-yet-existing file), then write_token, then add_or_update. Verified by research team.
notes: Fixed: NewRemote validated before write_token in run_enroll (both ssh-only and paired paths); finish() now takes the pre-built NewRemote so validation happens exactly once, before any disk write.

title: relay ensure_self_signed silently rotates cert when one of the pair is missing
description: crates/phux-relay/src/tls.rs ensure_self_signed guard is cert.exists() && key.exists(); with exactly one file missing it regenerates BOTH, silently rotating the pinned fingerprint and breaking every connector/consumer pin with opaque TLS failures. Fix: three-way match — both=ok, neither=generate, one=error naming the missing file and warning that deleting both rotates the fingerprint. Verified by research team.
notes: Fixed in BOTH sites (relay tls.rs and phux-server transport/tls.rs — same pattern existed server-side): three-way match, partial pair now errors with PartialTlsPair naming present/missing file instead of silently regenerating. Tests added in both modules.

title: Pane Kill sends group-SIGKILL, gives foreground claude no chance to flush
description: Secondary/lower-priority companion to phux-0db. TerminalSignal::Kill sends a group-SIGKILL via killpg (phux-server/src/terminal_actor/mod.rs:1324-1344, :1340-1343). Killing a pane from the client while claude is the foreground process (instead of exiting claude first) gives claude no chance to flush its transcript. The clean shell-exit path (handle_pty_eof, mod.rs:1749-1756) reaps gracefully and sends no signal, so 'quit claude, then exit the shell' is fine. Consider a graceful SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL with a grace window for pane kills.
notes: Implemented on branch claude-persistence. Root cause was more precise than the bead's pointer: the killpg-SIGKILL at deliver_signal (mod.rs:1324) is the DELIBERATE ADR-0033 TerminalSignal::Kill control (left as-is on purpose). The actual pane-CLOSE path (kill-pane action -> SPAWN_KILL / phux kill -> handle_kill_terminals -> detach_terminal_actor -> token cancel -> shutdown_pty) hard-killed via std Child::kill (SIGKILL of the shell pid, no grace). Fix: shutdown_pty now async; when the child is still alive it calls new terminate_child_group which SIGHUPs the process group (natural terminal-hangup; interactive shells act on it promptly, so idle-pane close stays snappy), polls try_wait up to PANE_KILL_GRACE (500ms), then SIGKILLs the group as backstop. Master stays open during grace so a foreground claude can still write its transcript flush. Added regression test pane_kill_lets_foreground_process_flush_before_death (traps SIGHUP, writes marker, asserts marker present) - verified it FAILS if the graceful signal is swapped to SIGKILL. fmt+clippy clean; full phux-server suite 596 passed.
